g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.text: Signal assignments follow the MS3-annotated V3.0 schematic, hardware guide page 197. Genuine module internals are not recreated.

g.desc: Signal assignments follow the MS3-annotated V3.0 schematic, hardware guide page 197. Genuine module internals are not recreated.

g.text: PM3 / PM4 / PM5 are repurposed LED ports: MIL, heater enable and optional EGR.

g.desc: PM3 / PM4 / PM5 are repurposed LED ports: MIL, heater enable and optional EGR.

g.text: These assignments require firmware output-resource review before use. USB and SD remain on the genuine card.

g.desc: These assignments require firmware output-resource review before use. USB and SD remain on the genuine card.

g.text: Legacy batch injector and stepper ports are exposed on the service header; no duplicate legacy injector stages fitted.

g.desc: Legacy batch injector and stepper ports are exposed on the service header; no duplicate legacy injector stages fitted.

g.text: Do not substitute an MS1/MS2 pinout. The module is powered through its documented 5 V and 12 V interfaces.

g.desc: Do not substitute an MS1/MS2 pinout. The module is powered through its documented 5 V and 12 V interfaces.
